outcome: Foetal Middle Cerebral Artery (MCA) doppler flow parameters (Pulsatility Index (PI), Resistance Index (RI), Peak Systolic Velocity (PSV), Systolic-To-Diastolic (S/D) ratio)
Admission to Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU)
cohort: Pregnant women attending antenatal care up to 34 weeks, categorized by Oral Glucose Tolerance Test (OGTT) results into GDM cases (OGTT >=140 mg/dL) and non-GDM controls (OGTT <140 mg/dL).
finding: Foetal MCA PI was significantly higher and MCA PSV significantly lower in the GDM group compared to non-GDM, and maternal complications, such as pregnancy-induced hypertension, were more frequent in GDM women.
